en.intro: This blue eco bag features the Pingu YUMMY design. Once you place an order, FeelBetter buys it from Pingu's official online store in Japan and ships it to you.
highlights: It is bought from Pingu's official online store in Japan, so you receive genuine Pingu merchandise.
An eco bag is a reusable carrier, handy for shopping and everyday errands.
The blue color and the YUMMY design give it a fresh, friendly look.
You can use it to carry your belongings whenever you go out.
A concierge checks the model, variant, stock and price before listing, so you can order with more confidence.

sections.p: Take it along for grocery trips or put your belongings in it when you go out. As a reusable bag, it is a handy alternative to a disposable shopping bag.

It suits Pingu fans who want a cheerful everyday bag, and anyone choosing a small gift. Because FeelBetter buys on demand from Japan, it is also a way to get Pingu items that are hard to find in Korea.

cautions: Exact size, material and whether it folds are not stated in the source listing; please check the photos.
